title: Onboard orionx-15b v1.0: metadata, perf profiles, and changelog automation
author: Ava Martinez
description: Motivation: Add support for a new community model 'orionx-15b' v1.0 to the registry with production-ready metadata, curated performance profiles for our serving runtime, and automation so the changelog/release notes are emitted when new models are onboarded. This PR bundles three related changes to make onboarding reproducible and reviewable: 1) model metadata and provenance files (license, SHA256, model card link, tokenizer info), 2) perf profiles (GPU/CPU profiles with representative throughput/latency numbers and recommended quantization/kv-cache settings), and 3) changelog generator updates + tests to automatically create a release notes entry when a new model directory is added. Checklist: - [x] Add models/orionx-15b/metadata.yaml with provenance and tags - [x] Add perf profiles under models/orionx-15b/perf_profiles/ (gpu_t4_16g.json, gpu_a100_80g.json, cpu_avx2.json) - [x] Update registry index to include orionx-15b - [x] Add changelog generation hooks and unit tests - [x] Lint / type-checks passing after fixes - [x] Docs snippet added to docs/model-registry/onboarding.md Notes: initial CI failed on a linting rule in scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py; addressed by standardizing date formatting and adding a small helper. Performance numbers are from automated runs in benchmark-lab (bench-2026-02-15) attached in commit messages; they include representative batch sizes and token lengths. Security: license verified as Apache-2.0 and SRI/SHA256 included.
commits_summary: 4 commits: add metadata and model card (commit 1), add GPU/CPU perf profiles and validation script (commit 2), add changelog generator hook + tests (commit 3), fix lint/type issues and update docs (commit 4). Each commit includes a short CI run reference to the benchmark job that produced the perf numbers.
files_changed: models/orionx-15b/metadata.yaml - adds model_name, version, sha256, license, model_card_url, tokenizer, recommended_quantization
models/orionx-15b/perf_profiles/gpu_a100_80g.json - throughput and p95 latency for gen-only and chat workloads; recommended batch/kv cache settings
models/orionx-15b/perf_profiles/gpu_t4_16g.json - constrained-GPU profile (memory-aware batch limits and quantization suggestions)
models/orionx-15b/perf_profiles/cpu_avx2.json - lightweight CPU profile for low-throughput fallbacks
registry/index.yaml - adds entry for orionx-15b with tags and default serving policy
scripts/changelog/generate_changelog.py - add detection for new model dirs and templated release note entry (includes unit tests)
tests/changelog/test_generate_entry.py - unit tests covering new model onboarding case
docs/model-registry/onboarding.md - doc snippet describing required metadata fields and perf-profile guidance
tools/perf/validate_perf_profile.py - small validator to ensure required keys exist in perf profiles
.github/workflows/registry-ci.yml - extends the registry CI matrix to include perf-profile validation step
benchmarks/bench-2026-02-15/orionx-15b-run-summary.md - attached run summary (not large binary logs)
scripts/changelog/__init__.py - export for new helper used by generator

release_notes:
- Added 'orionx-15b' v1.0 to model registry (Apache-2.0).
- Included curated performance profiles for A100-80G, T4-16G, and CPU AVX2 fallback.
- Automated changelog generation for new model onboarding so new entries are generated and tested as part of registry CI.
notes: This PR is part of the onboarding wave tracked in ENG-2219 and includes machine-readable perf profiles that the serving runtime can consume to auto-suggest default deployment configs. Downstream: redwood-helm-charts and redwood-private-installer should pick up the new registry index in their next sync.
